course_name_original: FPGAs and Analogue Signal Processors in Control Systems
course_name_en: FPGAs and Analogue Signal Processors in Control Systems

learning_outcomes.text: Knows the basics of arithmetic used in digital signal processing
Has basic knowledge of the structure, operation and use of CPLD and FPGA systems
Has basic knowledge of the structure, operation and use of analog programmable systems
Knows computer tools supporting the design processes of selected programmable systems
Knows the basics of the VHDL hardware description language
Has basic knowledge of the possibilities of using programmable systems in control systems of energy converters
Has basic knowledge of implementing DSP functions in FPGA systems
Is able to apply known methods, hardware description language and mathematical models, as well as computer techniques to implement algorithms in programmable systems
Is able to program and analyze the operation of an FPGA system algorithm using dedicated computer tools
Is able to program and analyze the operation of an FPGA system algorithm using dedicated computer tools
Understands the need for continuous learning related to rapid changes in programmable system technology

syllabus_topics: Computer design environment for FPGA systems
Basics of VHDL hardware description language
Techniques for implementing algorithms in FPGA systems
Debugging and control of FPGA projects
Implementation of control algorithms for power converters and their verification on numerical models of objects
SOFT CORE processor in FPGA system and use of C language
Dedicated software for CPLD and FPGA systems
Hardware description languages. Introduction to VHDL and design examples
Number formats, fixed-point and floating-point arithmetic
Implementation of DSP functions in FPGA systems
Implementation, in FPGA systems, of regulators and control with pulse width modulation for basic power electronic converters
Analog programmable systems FPAA and dpASP, concept, construction, dedicated software, switched capacitor technology
Concepts of implementing automatic control systems using FPGA and FPAA/dpASP
SOFT CORE processor in FPGA system and use of C language
assessment_rules: Completion of laboratory classes requires a positive assessment of the verification of learning outcomes. For lectures, students participate in classes and clarify doubts. Students are required to prepare for laboratory exercises, which may be verified by an oral or written colloquium.

T. Łuba, B. Zbierzchowski, K. Jasiński, „Specjalizowane układy cyfrowe w strukturach PLD i FPGA”, WKŁ, Warszawa, 1997
Philip Andrew Simpson, “FPGA Design”, Springer Cham, eBook ISBN 978-3-319-17924-7, Published: 19 May 2015.
